Hybrid Manufacturing of Composite Films via DLP Printing, IPL Sintering, and Acoustic Patterning

In this project, a hybrid manufacturing approach was taken to fabricate composite thin films to mitigate the limitations of individual manufacturing techniques. A combination of DLP printing, intense pulsed light (IPL) sintering, and acoustic patterning was used to fabricate metal-polymer composite thin films.

Objective

The project focused on creating a functional metal-polymer composite film with improved electrical conductivity and controlled microstructure by combining additive manufacturing, sintering, and acoustic patterning.

Key methods

  • DLP Printing
  • IPL Sintering
  • Acoustic Patterning
  • Optical Microscopy
  • Electrical Testing
  • Metal-Photopolymer Ink Development
